say:1:1322551001:1.text: You... You sinners! How dare you try to stop us from communicating with the spirits? The Great Will shall punish you for this!
say:1:1322551001:1.source_cn: 你……你们这些罪人，居然敢阻止我们和灵魂沟通“降灵”！...

say:2:1322551002:1.text: Great Will, please, bring your wrath upon those who've harmed your loyal servants!
say:2:1322551002:1.source_cn: 伟大意志啊！请求您降罪于这些伤害您忠诚信徒的人！

say:3:1322551003:1.text: Looks like they're not interested in talking... Let's just escort them back.
say:3:1322551003:1.source_cn: 看来和他们是无法正常沟通的……咱们还是把这些人押回去吧。
